overrides: Q1-R5 replaces every prior C01-C08 summary while retaining the non-conflicting detailed corpora and oracles from Q1-R through Q1-R4.
Q1-R5 expands correctness from eight to ten gates because F1-R4 public declarations, H1-R/H2-R native embedding and distribution provenance were not covered by the old eight-gate partition.
Q1-R5 does not add a performance workload or metric; P00-P13, M0/M1, the paired intersection-union verdict and environment protocol remain unchanged.
Q1-R5 defines every editor document-size label from Q1-R as MiU16 units; protocol frames, files, process footprint and transport labels remain bytes.
Q1-R5 replaces generic allocator denial with H2-R recoverable checkpoints and explicitly excludes fatal OOM recovery.
